title: Notify the crew
text: Tell the line crew and the shift supervisor that Line 3 is going down for maintenance.

title: Stop the line
text: Stop Line 3 from the control panel using the normal stop sequence.

title: Isolate energy
text: Turn the main isolator for Line 3 to OFF and close the compressed air valve at the supply.

title: Apply your lock
text: Fit your personal padlock to the isolator hasp and the air valve. Each person working on the line applies their own lock.

title: Attach your tag
text: Attach a tag to each lock showing your name, the date and the reason for the lockout.

title: Release stored energy
text: Bleed the air pressure at the bleed valve and wait until the gauge reads zero.

title: Try to start
text: Press the start button once at the panel to confirm the line does not move, then return the control to stop.

title: Verify zero energy
text: Check with the voltage tester that the isolator terminals read zero before touching any conductor.

title: Do the work
text: Carry out the maintenance. Keep your lock on until you have finished.

title: Remove your lock
text: When the work is done, check tools are clear, guards are refitted and everyone is out of the machine, then remove your own lock only.

title: Restart and inform
text: Restore energy, start the line from the panel and tell the crew the line is running.

title: Read the truck log
text: Read the previous shift's entries in the truck log for reported faults.

title: Walk around
text: Walk around the truck and look for damage, leaks and loose parts.

title: Forks and mast
text: Check the forks for cracks and bends and the mast chains for wear and correct tension.

title: Tyres
text: Check the tyres for cuts and flat spots and check the wheel nuts are tight.

title: Battery
text: Check the battery charge indicator reads above 30 percent and the battery restraint is secure.

title: Seat belt and horn
text: Fit the seat belt, then test the horn.

title: Lights and alarm
text: Test the headlights, the blue spot light and the reversing alarm.

title: Brakes and steering
text: Drive a few metres in the yard and test the service brake, the parking brake and the steering.

title: Sign the log
text: Record the result in the truck log and sign it. Report any fault to the supervisor and tag the truck out of service if it is unsafe.

title: Confirm tank empty and permit
text: Confirm Tank M2 is empty and that the supervisor has signed the CIP permit.

title: Put on PPE
text: Put on chemical goggles, face shield, caustic-resistant gloves and apron before opening any caustic line.

title: Pre-rinse
text: Pre-rinse the tank with water for 10 minutes until the drain runs clear.

title: Check caustic strength
text: Test the caustic solution with the titration kit. The concentration must be 1.5 to 2.0 percent.

title: Connect hoses
text: Connect the caustic supply hose and the return hose, and check both clamps are tight.

title: Circulate caustic
text: Start the CIP pump and circulate caustic at 70 degrees C for 20 minutes.

title: Record temperature
text: Read the temperature on the panel every 5 minutes and write it on the CIP sheet.

title: Drain caustic
text: Stop the pump, return the caustic to the CIP tank and drain the line.

title: Final rinse
text: Rinse the tank with fresh water for at least 15 minutes.

title: Check rinse water
text: Test the outlet water with pH strips. The reading must be 7 to 8 before sign-off.

title: Disconnect and cap
text: Disconnect the hoses with the line vented and cap the ports.

title: Close the permit
text: Complete the CIP sheet and have the supervisor sign the permit closed.
